page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.8xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 2.6 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate average multi-core capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 12260.17 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 9281.0. Single-core performance is a relative bottleneck, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the bottom 10% and Geekbench text processing categorized as weak. Memory bandwidth tests show a stark contrast: cached small-block reads achieve an average of 1571.99 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block reads and writes are weak at 35.37 GB/sec and 16.73 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a dense compute profile without the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU hardware. This makes it a viable option for compute-bound workloads that do not require high single-thread performance or massive memory footprints. Suitable workloads include multi-threaded applications, static web serving, Redis key-value stores, and parallelized software compilation.
